scope: 0–10% Pb–Pb geometry with pp hard channel, and matched vacuum baselines
normalization: sum of inverse-bias jet weights divided by sum of accepted event weights in each sample
uncertainty: Event-level delta method. C++ medium/vacuum uses paired hard draws; Fortran medium/vacuum and cross-implementation comparisons use independent-sample errors.

selection.particles: per-sample particle_level: native partons use status 3/4/5; hadron samples use final flag; exclude neutrino PDG 12/14/16

soft_drop.untagged: null zg and groomed_mass; counted separately

selection.mass: FastJet signed invariant mass in GeV; negative values retained

geometry_matching.assignment: hepyy_utils.match_hard_legs: maximize matches then minimize total distance
geometry_matching.order: all positive-pT jets before analysis cuts

selection.recoils: per-run keep_recoils flag; use projected_particles when projection is enabled, otherwise subtracted_particles when subtraction is enabled, otherwise raw hadronized_particles

cascade_nan_fix.finding: With NJOB 2600421, the first bad momentum arose in DOKINEMATICS during the first coherent transfer in the failing collision call. The centre-of-mass fallback set recoil momentum squared p42 to zero. Recomputing the equal projectile momentum squared as E4new² − m42 gave −1.4510723636004724 × 10⁻¹⁸ GeV². The square root at line 6090 made the x momentum of outgoing projectile line 280 nonfinite. The incoming projectile line 226 was finite. Later transfers propagated it into projectile line 290 and its vertex and time fields.
cascade_nan_fix.validation: The extended run used the same Fortran reshuffle fix with the discard guard disabled. All six medium shards passed the HepMC attempt ledger and finite-momentum checks. The Pythia6 seeds were verified from the RNG state.

pilot_metadata.seed_note: The pilot used NJOB 2600421 in the main Fortran medium and vacuum samples. JEWEL multiplies NJOB by 1,000 in a signed 32-bit integer, so those seeds wrapped. The larger comparison uses NJOB 600511–600516 and verified positive Pythia6 seeds. The pilot is shown as historical context.
